references.text: The commandment against misusing the Lord's name, which forbids using God's name for lies or falsehood
Repetition of the command not to misuse the Lord's name
Command to swear by the Lord's name, assuming that one must swear truthfully
The prophet Jeremiah condemns false oaths and says that the people swear falsely
Warning against those who swear by the Lord's name but not in truth
The vision of the flying scroll as a curse over those who swear falsely by the Lord's name
Exhortation not to love false oaths, for the Lord hates them
The Lord will testify against those who swear falsely
Jesus quotes the commandment against false oaths and expands on the teaching about swearing
James exhorts not to swear, but let your yes be yes and your no be no
